Read out of saint.gr's line for 24 Μαΐου, which names him inside Meletius's company as «Σεραπίων ο Aιγύπτιος», with the epithet kept and the rank word left off; the life page's own head line for him reads «Αγιος Σεραπιων ο Aιγυπτιος».

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 24 mai — «Sfântul Mucenic Serapion»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 24ης Μαΐου — «Άγιος Μελέτιος ο στρατηλάτης και οι συν αυτώ Μάρτυρες … Σεραπίων ο Aιγύπτιος …»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 24 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same civil day on which doxologia.ro prints the bare line «Sfântul Mucenic Serapion» that this folder was made from, and it gives him the company and the death the Romanian line withholds: he is «Σεραπίων ο Αιγύπτιος», the idolater who believed when he saw Meletius the Stratelates break the temple idols by his prayer, and was beheaded. **The match is on the day and on the name, which is the whole of what either source gives to match on**, and the Greek adds an epithet — the Egyptian — and a place in a company of twenty-two named martyrs under Elagabalus, 218 to 222. The folder's own text already says that the corpus's three other Serapions are kept on other days. No hymn is printed to him; his couplet says the martyr, not sacrificing to carved things, has his neck cut through by a worshipper of carved things.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).
